Crime & Law · India

Multiple drug seizures and arrests reported across India

Various Indian police forces have reported significant seizures of narcotics and arrests in recent operations. Incidents include large drug hauls in Bengaluru, Delhi, and Assam, as well as the apprehension of cybercriminals in Jharkhand. These actions highlight ongoing efforts to combat drug trafficking and cybercrime across different regions of the country.
